title: people-ops-recruiting-coordinator-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-21
content:
Morning checklist (Sat 2026-03-21)
- Quick wins first: confirm all interviews for next week, send follow-ups to candidates pending response.
- Check ATS (Greenhouse): update statuses for 6 active reqs.

Top priorities:
1) Priya N. (Backend Eng) — candidate needs reschedule from 9am to 11am PST. Hiring manager (Dana) confirmed 11am works; update invite + panel. Panel: Dana, Jordan R., Eng IC (TBD).
2) Marco L. (Data Science) — verbal offer numbers agreed, need written offer + comp approval from Dana & Finance by EOD. Reminder: include sign-on details and relocation stipend note.
3) Sourcing follow-up for UX PM req (GH-REQ-2026-045) — review new piped-in CVs, shortlist 4 to pass to Maya.

Candidate follow-ups to send today:
- Priya N. — reschedule confirmation + updated interview prep doc link. Timezones: candidate in IST (convert 11am PST -> 11:30pm IST) => double-check candidate availability before finalizing. (ACTION: send quick note 10:15am PST)
- Marco L. — send offer template draft; subject: "Redwood Inference — Offer Details"; cc: Dana, Finance. (ACTION: attach comp spreadsheet GH-REQ-2026-045/offer-2026-03-21.xlsx)
- Ana K. (SWE intern) — phone screen reminder 2pm PST; include interviewer prep (sample questions + rubric).
- Leo P. (SRE) — follow-up: asked for salary expectations, hasn't replied. If no reply by EOD, mark passive and deprioritize.

Interview scheduling notes / conflicts:
- Backend Eng onsite panel missing one interviewer (Eng IC out sick). Options: find alternate or move to next day. Note: avoid moving candidate twice.
- Timezone headaches: 3 PM CET interview (candidate in CET) maps to 6 AM PST — check with candidate if they'd prefer late afternoon PST slots.

Templates / quick copy snippets:
- Quick follow-up (scheduling): "Hi <Name>, thanks again for your time. Can you confirm availability for [date/time] PST? If not, please share 2-3 times that work for you. Best, Sophie"
- Post-screen note to hiring manager: "Candidate X completed phone screen. Strengths: A,B. Concerns: C. Recommendation: move to on-site / no-go / additional screen."

Open blockers / questions:
- Finance approval for Marco's offer — emailed Ricardo (finance) yesterday, no response. (Ping at 11:30am).
- Hiring manager (Dana) wants to increase band for Backend Eng req; need updated req approval form. (Linked JIRA: JIRA-REC-1287).
- Clarify relocation policy for interns — people-ops handbook page ambiguous. (Follow up with Maya).

To-dos (short):
- [ ] Send Priya reschedule email (10:15am)
- [ ] Ping Ricardo about Marco comp approval (11:30am)
- [ ] Finalize offer letter draft (attach comp sheet)
- [ ] Update Greenhouse statuses for: 5 candidates (mark phone screen complete)
- [ ] Add Ana K. interviewer notes template to invite
- [ ] Slack update in #recruiting: weekend coverage plan + who is on-call for scheduling

Notes to self / fragmented thoughts:
- Prep a short FAQ for candidates about Redwood Dedicated / Private deployments — recurring question from candidates (helps with interview prep).
- Consider batching scheduling emails to reduce context switching (template + 3 time options).
- Remember to cc TA-leads on offers to keep visibility.

End-of-day check:
- Confirm all outbound candidate messages sent
- Move any candidates who didn't respond to "follow-up 7 days" bucket
- Update hiring tracker spreadsheet with new interview outcomes

Misc:
- Quick reference links to include in emails: hiring playbook (confluence://people-ops/hiring-playbook), offer templates (drive link: drive.google.com/offer-templates), comp band table (drive.google.com/comp-bands-2026).

Unresolved / follow-ups for Monday:
- Confirm relocation policy for interns with Legal.
- Schedule brief sync with Dana to finalize Backend Eng band.

Scratch notes (messy):
- candidate Leo maybe over target, re-evaluate after salary ask.
- think about hiring pipeline for Q2: focus SRE + Backend + DS. more campus outreach?
- check last week's interview feedback: some raters inconsistent; need recalibration session (1-hr) next month.
summary: Daily scratchpad for people-ops recruiting coordinator: scheduling, candidate follow-ups, offer approvals, and quick templates. Priorities: reschedule Priya, finalize Marco's offer, update ATS and coordinate with Finance/Hiring Manager.
